title: A later estimate of trust
hook: Two stated cases: explore the effect of less favorable evidence on a pooled estimate.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the effect of less favorable evidence on a pooled estimate affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Mean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the effect of less favorable evidence on a pooled estimate in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
